resources.string: Could not read the edited text
Readability feedback for anything you write. No AI, no account, works offline.

There is nothing to set up, and nothing to do on this screen.

1. Select some text in any app
2. Tap Hemingway in the popup menu — it is often behind the ⋮ overflow
3. Adverbs, passive voice, complex phrases and hard sentences are highlighted
4. Edit it there, then tap Replace selection to send it back
The app requests no permissions at all — not even internet access. Everything is analysed on your device, so your writing cannot leave it.
